smc_logic: The 1H EMA20 (952.55) sits well below the current price, and the market shows a higher‑high/higher‑low structure. With price 8% above VWAP and RSI in overbought territory, a break of the 1,011 resistance would confirm a bullish swing; a drop below the 950‑level would invalidate the setup. Liquidity is balanced, so the next swing is likely to target the nearest order‑book imbalance.
smc_logic_short: Higher‑high/higher‑low, price > EMA20, VWAP gap, watch 1,011 break.
technical_analysis: HH‑HL bullish continuation on 1H, sideways 4H, down on lower timeframes; confluence of EMA, RSI, MACD and VWAP supports upside.
indicators_summary: EMA20/50/200 all below price, RSI 73, MACD +2.9 histogram, VWAP 898 vs price 983, Bollinger position 0.73 near upper band, Stoch RSI flat at 0.
